name: Ore no Yome ~Anata Dake no Hanayome~
original_name: 俺の嫁 ～あなただけの花嫁～
source:
The game starts with you confessing to your girlfriend on the rooftop of your high school. You then get married and spend the remainder of the game spending time with your wife. You take her out shopping, go on dates to amusement parks or the mall, share dinner together, just basic newlywed stuff. There's special events which come up from time to time, like having a terrible day at work your wife will comfort you, getting in an argument with her, helping her cook dinner, and so on.

[From [url=http://www.crunchyroll.com/forumtopic-781950/ore-no-yome-anata-dake-no-hanayome]a forum post by Tekrelious[/url]].
translation:
游戏从你在高中天台上向女朋友表白开始。然后你们结婚，在剩余的游戏时间里和妻子一起度过。你带她去购物、去游乐园或商场约会、一起吃晚餐，就是基本的新婚生活。还有一些不时出现的特殊事件，比如工作上遇到糟糕的一天妻子会安慰你、和她吵架、帮她做晚饭等等。

[来自[url=http://www.crunchyroll.com/forumtopic-781950/ore-no-yome-anata-dake-no-hanayome]Tekrelious的论坛帖子[/url]]。
